import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    # first integer is n (not used)
    a1 = int(data[1])
    a3 = int(data[2])
    a2 = int(data[3])
    b1 = int(data[4])
    b3 = int(data[5])
    b2 = int(data[6])
    min_val = 0
    max_val = 0
    max_val += a1 if a1 < b3 else b3
    max_val += a2 if a2 < b1 else b1
    max_val += a3 if a3 < b2 else b2
    min_val += (a1 - (b2 + b1)) if a1 > b2 + b1 else 0
    min_val += (a2 - (b3 + b2)) if a2 > b3 + b2 else 0
    min_val += (a3 - (b1 + b3)) if a3 > b1 + b3 else 0
    sys.stdout.write(f"{min_val} {max_val}\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
